question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as a goal
Great accomplishment is the subject of becoming
The result is becoming dear to the yoginīs
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation.
